items.a: No. Stress is a **generic mobilization system**. **Acute epinephrine** sharpens cognition, narrows focus, and **primes immune defense**; chronic elevation drives heart disease.

items.q: How do short, medium, and long stress differ?
items.a: **Short-term** is often beneficial; **medium-term** (weeks) is for raising your stress threshold; **long-term/chronic** is harmful. When you **can't sleep well**, you've crossed from acute into chronic.

items.q: What is the physiological sigh and how fast does it work?
items.a: **Double inhale + long exhale**, **1–3 reps**. It reinflates collapsed alveoli, clears **CO₂** (an agitation driver), and can drop heart rate in ~**20–30 seconds** — the fastest self-directed calm Huberman knows.

items.q: How do inhale and exhale length control heart rate?
items.a: **Inhale > exhale** speeds the heart (stress); **exhale > inhale** slows it via the sinoatrial node ↔ brainstem **parasympathetic** loop.

sections.title: Use acute stress, raise the threshold

items.q: Can deliberate adrenaline help your immune system?
items.a: Acute stress mobilizes **killer cells**. A **25-cycle** Wim Hof/Tummo-style hyperventilation protocol blunted E. coli endotoxin symptoms in a PNAS study — **never near water**; get physician clearance.

items.q: How do you keep a calm mind while the body is amped?
items.a: Train **mind calm / body activated** (cold, sprint, high HR) and use **panoramic gaze**: stress tunnels vision; deliberately widening the visual field releases a brainstem alertness circuit while the body stays at **80–90%** max.

items.q: Why do people get sick on vacation?
items.a: A **sustained adrenaline crash** after chronic stress can cause an **immune crash**. Don't let acute stress become chronic — **sleep is the canary**.

items.q: What social habits reduce long-term stress?
items.a: **Genuine social connection**, play, and delight release **serotonin** with immune/repair benefits. Recognizing trusted people matters; **digital connection is a weak proxy**.

items.q: Which supplements does Huberman mention when behavior isn't enough?
items.a: **L-theanine 100–200 mg** and **ashwagandha** for acute stress periods only. **Avoid melatonin** supplementation — typical **1–3 mg** is supraphysiological with reproductive-axis concerns.
